data.text: My family taught me to leave enough fish for next season, and our village depends on us doing that. With 100 tons in the lake, we can catch 50 tons total each month and let the remaining 50 double back to 100. How about 10 tons each? That’s $10,000 apiece every month without depleting the lake. I propose we all agree to that limit before choosing, then review the reported catches together each month. John, would you support that?
